task_summary: Customer's Glass Coffee Carafe from ORD-6023 arrived damaged due to crushed packaging. Correct handling is the shipping-damage path: review shipping and return policy, refund the item, issue a return label, and apply fragile-item goodwill credit if the item is classified as fragile.

Agent must process item ITEM-9155 with reason damaged_in_transit, not changed_mind.
